chunk_map.heading: Generic AI is everyone's; your material is yours

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 0 line 6: "Put that in front of the agent" — closest; 'that' resolves to the list it follows (interviews, tickets, analytics, calls) in the same sentence pair; 'them' (l.4) = competitors, named in the same sentence. Harm (unresolvable referent) absent.

rules_evaluated.na_reason: no pointer at another file or position; grep for opening/earlier/previous lecture: 0

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no 'the X you did/saw/caught' reference; line 6 'the calls you made and why' names the team's material, not a module beat

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no guess/predict or demo beat; l.8 'A quick test' is a verbed instruction

rules_evaluated.evidence: lines 4-8: three self-carrying paragraphs (same models, your material, competitor test); closest = l.8 test paragraph, still carries a full claim.
l.1 "Generic AI is everyone's; your material is yours" — l.4 'same models … much the same answer' and l.6 'become yours' both support it; nothing contradicts.

closest: l.4-6 'Your competitors… What they cannot use…' contrast pair, a declarative, not 'Not X. Not Y. Z.'; no anaphora triple, superlative, number+retraction, abstraction-noun stack or verb triplet. grep 'most useful|best|powerful' → 0.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -i 'compendium|forcing function|beat|mood|surface' over body l.1-8 → 0; closest l.6 'material' is ordinary English. Maintainer dialect (map row, squint) sits below the cut only.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -c '\*\*' on body l.1-8 → 0 bold (the 2 hits are in the maintainer tail).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: slide file is a '##' chunk with <!--slide:generic-becomes-yours--> l.2 and is included from curriculum/lectures/apt101-your-material-is-the-moat.md (grep -rln 'slides/generic-becomes-yours' curriculum → lecture hit); a lecture include reaches the deck.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-numbering.js --file curriculum/slides/generic-becomes-yours.md → OK — 1 files, Phase/Step numbering consistent.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-deixis.js --file curriculum/slides/generic-becomes-yours.md → OK — 1 files, no page-geometry pointers across the slide cut.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: In-deck links work now; whether they EARN their place is open.
Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file curriculum/slides/generic-becomes-yours.md → slides: 1, oversized: 0, every slide within limits.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: l.1 "Generic AI is everyone's; your material is yours" is a declarative claim, correct for a lecture slide; not an exercise.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: closest: l.8 'A pattern from your own tickets does not.' — completes the competitor test with the concrete contrast, adds an object rather than restating the header (not a class-c kicker); no doctrine restatement or design commentary.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: first cut per maintainer STATUS; header and body written together, no inherited bullets

notes: Single-slide file; accept-notes: one dated STATUS line (no accept for any slides rule). Slide inlined by apt101-your-material-is-the-moat lecture. 'the agent' (l.6) is a generic definite noun in an agents training, not a referent defect.
